newsitem.title: USA: Accent Software unit appoints new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Accent Software unit appoints new chief executive.

text.p: AgentSoft Ltd said on Wednesday that Todd Oseth would become the company's new chief executive officer as part of a general reorganization.
Oseth has also served as the chief executive and president of Accent Software International Ltd, AgentSoft's parent company, since February.
AgentSoft also said that its president Gilad Zlotkin and vice-president of research Eithan Ephrati had left the company as part of the reorganization.
AgentSoft develops and markets tools, services and applications for the Internet and the corporate intranet.
